verdict.rationale: Portkey acts as a unified gateway supporting 250+ models and OpenAI-compatible SDK integration, and explicitly supports connecting to remote MCP servers for external tool use, implying tool/function-call routing across providers. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a unified function/tool-calling schema translation layer (e.g., normalizing OpenAI-style tool calls to Anthropic/Gemini formats) or streaming tool-call specifics. missing for 10: explicit docs on cross-provider function/tool-call schema normalization, streaming tool-call examples, independent/hands-on verification of consistent tool-call behavior across providers.
